mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5.25% in the month preceding the forecast period is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financial conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the mean of the prior 30 months (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not cross the threshold in the observed window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% for three consecutive months, labor market slack increases, reducing expected corporate profit margins and producing a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in at least 70% of similar 3-month UNRATE < 5% periods (empirical robustness test).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both HOUST (industrial production) and GDPC1 (personal consumption) by at least 2% over the prior month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals robust economic demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST up ≥2% AND GDPC1 up ≥2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 5 backtests with similar dual-proxy up moves.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (industrial production) index below 100 for two consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, leading to a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in 80% of INDPRO < 100 periods (rolling 12 months).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in a single month, the expectation of future inflation erodes equity valuations, producing a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negatively correlated with CPIAUCSL surprise inflation (Spearman's ρ < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in PAYEMS (employment) by 2,000 or more jobs in a month coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates recession risk.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative in 4 backtests with similar job losses (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (production) by at least 3% in the same quarter are associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to strong demand signals.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS up ≥3% AND HOUST up ≥3% in the same quarter
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significant in 5 backtests with similar double-proxy up moves (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS increases above 6%, the 60-day S&P 500 forward return tends to be negative due to higher discount rates applied to equity cash flows from tighter policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% of FEDFUNDS > 6% periods (rolling 12 months).
